senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be heavy; (cmp. כָּבֵד, חוּמְרָא &c.) to be weighty, important, honored; [to be dear, precious; to hold dear, v. infra.] Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 27">B’shall. 27</cite> <he>יָקְרוּ ידיו של משה וכ׳</he> Moses’ hands grew as heavy as &c.; Mekh. B’shall., Amalek, s. 1. Ib. <he>י׳ חטא על וכ׳</he> sin weighed heavily on Moses’ hands.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>אני מגדול ומְיַיקֵּר אתכם וכ׳</he> I shall make you great and honored &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23">Num. R. s. 23</cite>, end (ref. to a citation <he>כי הנני משלחך כגבירה</he>, found nowhere in the Bible—probably a reference to <cite ref="Jeremiah 22:26">Jer. XXII, 26</cite> a.

XXIX, 2) מה הגבירה הזו אדם מְיַקּר אותה וכ׳ (or מֵיקַי Kal) as one (surely) holds in honor the g’birah (king’s mother), so did he (Nebucadnezar) to him (Jehoiachin); Tanḥ. Massé 13; ib. ed. Bub. 10 אדם מיקר לה. (Gen. R. s. 18 מיקרת ראשה she bears her head proudly; Yalk. Gen. 24; Yalk. Is. 265 מקלת, v. קָלַל).—Part. pass. מְיוּקָּר. Num. R. l. c. קשר אותו בקורכין שלו מי׳ he tied (and seated) him in his most honored (state) carriage; Tanḥ. l. c. … בקורנין וכ׳; ib. ed. Bub. l. c. קשר אותו בקרובין ומוֹקֵר לו (Ms. M. בקרונין) he tied … and paid him honor.

senses.gloss: to grow dear, scarce; to rise in value. Y. Keth. XI, 34ᵇ bot. ה׳ המקח the price of the field was higher (than the amount due her for alimentation). Ib. XII, beg. 34ᵈ היו בזול והוֹקִירוּ, v. זוֹל.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:9">B. Mets. V, 9</cite> <he>שמא יוֹקִירוּ חטים</he> wheat may rise in value; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to honor. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:8">B. Bath. V, 8</cite> <he>והוּקְרוּ</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:8">B. Mets. V, 8</cite> <he>הוקרו</he> (Y. ed. <he>הוקירו</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35">Gen. R. s. 35</cite> <he>ה׳ השמן</he> oil became scarce (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 228">Yalk. Kings 228</cite> <cite ref="J00580"><he>הוקיר</he></cite>); a. fr.
